rows.en:
Maybe I'll wander around the school
for a bit...

The art room, huh...
Maybe I'll take a look inside...
Luuu-caaa!

What's up? Lost in thought
in the art room?
N-No, i-it's nothing...

Ahh~ I get it, I get it...
Well, that's youth for you!!
rows.notes: x2, both genders. The player assumes Luca is in love (with someone in the art room).

rows.en:
Sorry, I didn't pick up on it at all.
I'm rooting for you!

W-Wait, aren't you getting
the wrong idea here!?
(Hahaha, hang in there, Luca!)
(School's finally out...)

The art room, huh...
Maybe I'll take a peek...
Heeey, Luca-kuuun.
Luuu-caaa-kuuun!

Why didn't you tell me~? You could've
come to me...! If I'm any help,
I'll cheer you on all you want!!
rows.notes: Female. mizukusai = don't keep it from me.

rows.en: (Hehehe, good luck, Luca-kun!!)
I sense someone in the art room...
Lost in thought in the art room again?

If something's bothering you, I'll listen, okay?
Sometimes talking it out
makes you feel better.
...No, this is my own problem...

...Really?
Well, I'm rooting for you anyway.
...Okay. Thank you.
(...Hang in there, Luca!!)
Heeey, Luca-kuuun~
Luuu-caaa-kyuuun!
rows.notes: Female. kyuun = cutesy distortion of kun, kept as 'kyuuun'.

rows.en:
...Really?
Well, I'm rooting for you anyway.
(...Hang in there, Luca-kun!)
(Okay, maybe I'll head home soon...)
\p, got a sec?
rows.notes: x4: Michel (frd_mcl_001) and Gary (scd_com), both genders.

rows.en: Hm? You need something from me, Michel?

Yeah, kind of...
You free after this?
Yeah, I'm free, I guess...

Glad to hear it.
Then keep me company for a bit.

Sure, but where are we going,
and what for?

Oh, to check out a new cafe
ahead of time.
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. No accent (Shift-JIS).

rows.en: ...Check out a cafe?

The atmosphere and the clientele are both
decent. The food's a safe bet too...
This place should work fine for a date.

(I see, so he's scouting a place
for a date.)

Is careful groundwork the secret
to being popular with girls,
Michel-sensei?

Well, doing this much homework
is just common sense.
Common sense, huh...

You've gotta get to where you can
casually bring a girl to a place like this
too, y'know.

But if everyone were like that,
you'd be in trouble too, right, Michel?
Haha, you've got a point there.

Come to think of it, there's one thing
I've been wondering about...

Why'd you ask me along?
You could've scouted it on your own, right?

Let's see...
Two guys having tea together is a bit iffy,
but it beats coming alone.

So you invited me because you wanted
someone to talk to?
That's part of it, but...
Hm?

If I sat having tea all by myself,
the older ladies around me
wouldn't leave me alone.
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. onee-sama-gata = 'the older ladies', as other Michel rows (c10330, c24217).

rows.en: Hey, I'm not your woman repellent!

Hahaha, I'm kidding.
Don't pout like that.
rows.notes: x3, Michel, both genders (twice in the female scene).

rows.en: Hahahaha!
rows.notes: x4: Michel and the player, both genders.

rows.en:
(Still, Michel really goes to
a lot of trouble over this stuff.)

(Hmm~ Maybe I should try a little harder
too, like Michel...?)
(Okay, maybe I'll head home soon...)

Hm? You need something from me,
Michel-kun?

Sure, but where are we going,
and what for?

(I see, so he's scouting a place
for a date.)

Is careful groundwork the secret
to being popular with girls,
Michel-sensei?

Oh, come to think of it, there's one
thing I've been wondering about...

Why'd you ask me along?
You could've scouted it on your own, right?

Having tea as a lone guy
is kinda lonely, you know.

So you invited me because you wanted
someone to talk to?

Geez, Michel-kun,
I'm not your woman repellent!
Honestly, Michel-kun...

(Still, Michel-kun really goes to
a lot of trouble over this stuff.)
(I guess that's Michel-kun for you.)

(School's over, so maybe I'll stop
somewhere on the way home.)

Yo, \p.
Heading home now?
Yeah, that's the plan.

Remember that cafe we checked out before?
Wanna go there now?

Sure, but...
What's the occasion today?
Truth is...
I just wanted to come have tea with you.

(The way he was dragging it out,
I thought something was up...)

C'mon, let's enjoy some tea time,
just the two of us.

(Michel sure gets a kick out of
teasing people...)

(Sigh~ Oh well.
I'll just enjoy having tea with Michel.)

Sure, but...
What's the occasion today?

uncertain: c09807: in the female version of frd_mcl_001 the line also sits right after the player asks why Michel invited her (before c09818), where it reads a little abruptly; it is a shared fixed line.
c09761/c09762/c09769: the player assumes Luca is lovesick (presumably over Nanase); kept implicit as in the Japanese.
